name: smart-attendance-system
description: Smart Attendance System (MERN + face-api.js) monorepo launcher

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run install:all && npm run dev
